tactics_set_1_1_description: Grind down the enemy to shatter their resolve.
tactics_set_1_1_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if any enemy units were destroyed this turn
tactics_set_1_1_conditions_2: More enemy units than friendly units were destroyed this turn.
tactics_set_1_1_command_description: These warriors stand fast and ready themselves for an oncoming attack.
tactics_set_1_1_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
tactics_set_1_1_command_steps_2_descript: That unit has STRIKE-FIRST this turn.
tactics_set_1_2_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are more friendly models contesting the large terrain feature in your territory than there are enemy models contesting it.
tactics_set_1_2_command_description: This champion is not one to shy away from battle.
tactics_set_1_2_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly HERO to use this ability.
tactics_set_1_3_description: Drive deep into enemy territory and wreak havoc!
tactics_set_1_3_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if any friendly units are wholly within enemy territory and not in combat.
tactics_set_1_3_command_title: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability.
tactics_set_1_3_command_description: These warriors assume a defensive formation that blunts the blows of the enemy.
tactics_set_1_3_command_steps_1_descript: A friendly unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
tactics_set_1_3_command_steps_2_descript: Ignore the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that unit this phase.
tactics_set_1_4_description: Nobel Dracothion is marked upon this hallowed ground.
tactics_set_1_4_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic if you control the Dracothion objective at the end of your turn.
tactics_set_1_4_command_title: Reaction: Opponent declared a SHOOT ability.
tactics_set_1_4_command_description: These warriors take cover to avoid a volley directed at them.
tactics_set_1_4_command_steps_1_descript: A friendly unit target by that SHOOT ability.
tactics_set_1_4_command_steps_2_descript: Until the end of the phase, only unmodified hit rolls of 6 succesfully hit for attacks that target that unit. However, that unit has STRIKE-LAST this turn.
tactics_set_1_5_description: Take the dias of Ignax so that we are filled with her fury and wrath.
tactics_set_1_5_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic if you control the Ignax objective at the end of your turn.
tactics_set_1_5_command_title: Reaction: You declare a CHARGE ability.
tactics_set_1_5_command_description: A rousing command gives the unit renewed energy to reach their foes.
tactics_set_1_5_command_steps_1_descript: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
tactics_set_1_5_command_steps_2_descript: You can re-roll the charge roll.
tactics_set_1_6_description: Claim the sigil of Behemat so that we might be blessed with his strength.
tactics_set_1_6_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic if you control the Behemat objective at the end of your turn.
tactics_set_1_6_command_description: Upon this parchment is an eldrich incantation that can loose a blast of destructive magic.
tactics_set_1_6_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly HERO to use this ability, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them, then roll a dice.
tactics_set_1_6_command_steps_2_descript: On a 2+, inflic D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
tactics_set_1_7_description: Surround the enemyu before you close in for the kill.
tactics_set_1_7_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are any friendly units within 3" of each short battlefield edge.
tactics_set_1_7_command_description: Taking initiative the warriors hastily reposition to respond to enemy movements.
tactics_set_1_7_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
tactics_set_1_7_command_steps_2_descript: That unic can move up to D6". That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
tactics_set_1_8_description: Break through enemy lines and lay waste to the lands beyond.
tactics_set_1_8_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are any friendly units within 3" of the long battlefield edge in enemy territory.
tactics_set_1_8_command_description: With heroic conviction, this mighty warrior stands firm in the face of the enemy.
tactics_set_1_8_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly HERO to use this ability.
tactics_set_1_8_command_steps_2_descript: Roll a dice. For the rest of the turn, add the number rolled to the control score of that HERO.
tactics_set_1_9_description: The enemy leaves a critical position unguarded. Claim it!
tactics_set_1_9_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you gain control of an objective that was controlled by your opponent at the start of the turn.
tactics_set_1_9_conditions_2: None of the units contesting that objective used a FIGHT ability this turn.
tactics_set_1_9_command_title: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability.
tactics_set_1_9_command_description: With grit and zeal, these warriors fight till the bitter end.
tactics_set_1_9_command_steps_1_descript: A friendly unit target by that ATTACK ability.
tactics_set_1_9_command_steps_2_descript: That unit has WARD (5+) this phase.
tactics_set_1_10_description: We must not falter on any front. Stand fast, and keep the enemy at bay.
tactics_set_1_10_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if any friendly units used a FIGHT ability this turn
tactics_set_1_10_conditions_2: No friendly units were destroyed this turn.
tactics_set_1_10_command_title: Reaction: You declared a RETREAT ability.
tactics_set_1_10_command_description: A unit breaks away from the enemy in order to rally scattered and wounded warriors.
tactics_set_1_10_command_steps_1_descrip: The unit using that RETREAT ability.
tactics_set_1_10_command_steps_2_descrip: No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by the RETREAT ability. In addition, after the ability is resolved, roll 1 dice for each slain model from that unit. For each 5+, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.
tactics_set_1_11_description: Claim the head of the enemy's general to shatter their morale.
tactics_set_1_11_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if the enemy general was slain this turn OR the enemy general was slain in an earlier turn and any enemy units were destroyed this turn.
tactics_set_1_11_command_description: These warriors charge forth to stall the enemy's advance or enact a bold interception.
tactics_set_1_11_command_steps_1_descrip: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
tactics_set_1_11_command_steps_2_descrip: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.
tactics_set_1_12_description: Divide and conquer by approaching the foe from two directions.
tactics_set_1_12_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control 2 objectives that were controlled by your opponent at the start of the turn.
tactics_set_1_12_command_description: The rallying blare of the war horns calls fresh warriors to battle.
tactics_set_1_12_command_steps_1_descrip: Pick a friendly INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit with 5 or more models that has been destroed and has not already been replaced.
tactics_set_1_12_command_steps_2_descrip: Set up a replacement unit consisting of D3 models from that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
tactics_set_2_1_description: Sanctify this ground with an offering of death.
tactics_set_2_1_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective not wholly within friendly territory. It cannot be the Dais of Blood or the Dais of the Necropolis.
tactics_set_2_1_command_description: Death is not the end here...
tactics_set_2_1_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly unit that has been destroyed and has not already been replaced.
tactics_set_2_1_command_steps_2_descript: Set up either a replacement unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 4 or a single-model replacement unit with X damage points already allocated to it, where X is its Health characteristic minus 4. The unit must be set up more than 6" from all enemy units.
tactics_set_2_2_description: Divide and conquer by approaching the foe from two directions.
tactics_set_2_2_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control 2 objectives that were controlled by your opponent at the start of the turn.
tactics_set_2_2_command_title: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
tactics_set_2_2_command_description: The touch of Shyish brieflyh turns these warriors to phantoms.
tactics_set_2_2_command_steps_1_descript: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
tactics_set_2_2_command_steps_2_descript: For the rest of the phase, if the unmodified hit roll or wound roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
tactics_set_2_3_description: Grind down the enemy to shatter their resolve.
tactics_set_2_3_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if any enemy unit were destroyed this turn.
tactics_set_2_3_conditions_2: more enemy units than friendly units were destroyed this turn
tactics_set_2_3_command_description: Death comes on swift wings; one need only allow themselves to be carried.
tactics_set_2_3_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly unit in combat.
tactics_set_2_3_command_steps_2_descript: Remove that unit from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
tactics_set_2_4_description: Roam these benighted domains and engage any foe you see.
tactics_set_2_4_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if a friendly unit used a FIGH ability this turn
tactics_set_2_4_conditions_2: that unit is not contesting an objective and is on the battlefield.
tactics_set_2_4_command_description: A life-draining corona of amethyst magic surrounds your champion.
tactics_set_2_4_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly HERO contesting an objective to use this ability, then p ick each enemy unit contesting that objective.
tactics_set_2_4_command_steps_2_descript: Roll a dice for each of those enemy units. On a 4+, inflict 2 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
tactics_set_2_5_description: The enemy leaves a critical position unguarded. Claim it!
tactics_set_2_5_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you gain control of an objective that was controlled by your opponent at the start of the turn
tactics_set_2_5_conditions_2: none of the units contesting that objective used a FIGHT ability this turn.
tactics_set_2_5_command_description: This alabaster edifice is redolent with power.
tactics_set_2_5_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a terrain feature within friendly territory to be the target.
tactics_set_2_5_command_steps_2_descript: The target is also treated as an objective.
tactics_set_2_6_description: Hold Neferata's sigil to be granted her dark favour.
tactics_set_2_6_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic if you control the Dais of Blood at the end of your turn.
tactics_set_2_6_command_description: These warriors hurl themselves into the fray as if possessed by a red hunger.
tactics_set_2_6_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
tactics_set_2_6_command_steps_2_descript: Add 1 to Attacks characteristics of that unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. However, that unit has a maximum control score of 1 for th rest of the battle round.
tactics_set_2_7_description: Surround the enemy before you close in for the kill
tactics_set_2_7_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control 2 objectives not wholly within friendly territory.
tactics_set_2_7_command_description: These warriors hastily reposition or reform their ranks
tactics_set_2_7_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
tactics_set_2_7_command_steps_2_descript: If that unit is in combat, it can use a RETREAT ability as if it were your movement phase. If that unit is not in combat: A) If it is not damaged, roll a dice for each slain model from that unit. For each 5+, you can return 1 slain model to that unit. B) If it is damaged, roll a dice for each damage point it has. For each 5+, Heal (1) that unit.
tactics_set_2_8_description: Drive deep into enemy territory and wreak havoc!
tactics_set_2_8_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if any friendly units are wholly within enemy territory and not in combat.
tactics_set_2_8_command_description: This sudden onslaught disrupts the cohesion of the foe with its sheer ferocity.
tactics_set_2_8_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
tactics_set_2_8_command_steps_2_descript: Roll a dice. Subtract the roll from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.
tactics_set_2_9_description: Seek out death in every quarter of the battlefield - yours or the enemy's.
tactics_set_2_9_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if any models were slain within friendly territory and any models were slain within enemy territory.
tactics_set_2_9_command_description: These warriors stand fast and ready themselves for an oncoming attack.
tactics_set_2_9_command_steps_1_descript: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
tactics_set_2_9_command_steps_2_descript: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.
tactics_set_2_10_description: This land is yours, let no foe take it from you.
tactics_set_2_10_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control the large terrain feature within friendly territory.
tactics_set_2_10_command_description: Use the carnage of the churning melee to press your attack.
tactics_set_2_10_command_steps_1_descrip: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to be the target.
tactics_set_2_10_command_steps_2_descrip: The target can move 3". It can move into combat.
tactics_set_2_11_description: Break through enemy lines and lay waste to the lands beyond.
tactics_set_2_11_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are any friendly units within 3" of the long battlefield edge in enemy territory.
tactics_set_2_11_command_description: With grit and zeal, these warriors seek to bring the fight to their enemies.
tactics_set_2_11_command_steps_1_descrip: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
tactics_set_2_11_command_steps_2_descrip: Add D3 to charge rolls for that unit for the rest of the turn.
tactics_set_2_12_description: The forbidding icon of Katakros marks this land.
tactics_set_2_12_conditions_1: You complete this battle tactic if you control the Dais of the Necropolis at the end of your turn.
tactics_set_2_12_command_description: Fight with reckless abandon to annihilate the enemy.
tactics_set_2_12_command_steps_1_descrip: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
tactics_set_2_12_command_steps_2_descrip: That unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first one is used, however, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit and it has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
twist_ossia_1_description: The cold shadow of a deathless empire falls upon the battlefield, steeling some but debilitating others.
twist_ossia_1_content_1_description: The underdog can pick 1 of the effects below. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner can pick the effect.
twist_ossia_1_content_2_description: Pick a friendly unit on the battlefield to be the target. Ignore all modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) for the rest of the battle round.
twist_ossia_1_content_3_description: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target. The target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the battle round.
twist_ossia_2_description: The advance into enemy territory is inexorable as both sides attempt to seize the advantage.
twist_ossia_2_content_1_description: Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of their turn for each objective not wholly within their territory that they control which is not contested by any enemy units.
twist_ossia_2_content_2_description: In addition, if one of the players is the underdog, they can pick a friendly unit and then roll a D6. Add the result to that unit's control score for the rest of the battle round.
twist_ossia_3_description: Nothing can distract these warriors from taking and holding this crucial ground.
twist_ossia_3_content_2_description: If there is no underdog, each player picks 1 objective, starting with the active player.
twist_ossia_3_content_3_description: Each player scores 2 extra victory points at the end of their turn if they control both objectives.
twist_ossia_4_description: A relentless and macabre hail of skulls forces warrior's heads down and wears at their resolve.
twist_ossia_4_content_1_description: The underdog can pick an objective. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner can pick an objective.
twist_ossia_4_content_2_description: Subtract 1 from hit rollw for enemy units while they are contesting that objective for the rest of the battle round.
twist_ossia_5_description: A reliable chain of resupply provides a tangible advantage in the battle to come.
twist_ossia_5_content_1_description: The underdog picks 2 terrain features. If there is no underdog, each player picks a different terrain feature. Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of their turn if they control both terrain features.
twist_ossia_5_content_2_description: In addition, the underdog can pick 1 friendly unit. For the rest of the battle round, while that unit contests either of the terrain features that were picked, it has WARD (5+).
twist_ossia_6_description: Imbued with Ossian precision, these warriors prepare to meet the enemy with flawless resistance.
twist_ossia_6_content_1_description: The underdog can pick 1 of the effects below. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner can pick the effect.
twist_ossia_6_content_2_description: Pick a friendly unit. For the rest of the battle round, while that unit is wholly within friendly territory, it has STRIKE-FIRST
twist_ossia_6_content_3_description: Pick an enemy unit. For the rest of the battle round, while that unit is wholly within friendly territory, it has STRIKE-LAST.
twist_dolorum_1_description: A baleful shrine materialises out of the darkness, the air around it thick with a whispering curse.
twist_dolorum_1_content_1_description: The underdog reveals the Icon of Nulahmia. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner reveals the Icon of Nulahmia. The player that reveals the Icon of Nulahmia places the Icon of Nulahmia terrain feature anywhere on the battlefield, more than 3" from each other terrain feature, more than 3" from all units (friendly and enemy) and not touching an objective.
twist_dolorum_2_description: A pall of sorrow wells up on the battlefield, spreading bleakness and despair.
twist_dolorum_2_content_1_description: The underdog picks an objective. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner picks an objective. That objective is no longer controlled by either player and cannot be controlled this battle round.
twist_dolorum_3_description: Grief turns into a ferocious desire for retribution, where only bloodshed can salve a warrior's sorrow.
twist_dolorum_3_content_1_description: Each player scores 1 victory point at the end of their turn for each friendly unit that is in combat with any enemy units.
twist_dolorum_3_content_2_description: If there is an underdog, at the end of their turn, if there are more destroyed friendly units than destroyed enemy units, they score 1 additional victory point.
twist_dolorum_4_description: The cries of the recently dead spur their fellows to fight on despite the odds.
twist_dolorum_4_content_1_description: Each player scores 1 victory poñint at the end of their turn for each friendly unit that is destroyed or that is a replacement unit.
twist_dolorum_4_content_2_description: If there is an underdog, then they can piñck 1 friendly unit. If there is no underdog, then the players roll off and the winner can pick a friendly unit. That unic can user CHARGE abilities even if they used a RETREAT or RUN ability in the same turn.
twist_dolorum_5_description: Overcoming the rasping promises of the damned, these warriors find the courage to forge into the shadows.
twist_dolorum_5_content_1_description: Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of their turn for each objective they control that was controlled by their opponent at the start of their turn.
twist_dolorum_5_content_2_description: In addition, if there is an underdog, they can pick 1 friendly unit. That unit's melee weapon have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) for the rest of the battle round.
twist_dolorum_6_description: Unnatural night falls and spirits coalesce around the places of death.
twist_dolorum_6_content_2_description: If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner picks an objective.
twist_dolorum_6_content_3_description: For the rest of the battle round, that objective is treated as being contested by a friendly unit of the player that picked it. That unit has a control score of 1 that cannot be modified.
twist_dolorum_6_content_4_description: If there are any enemy units contesting that objective, you'll need to have a higher control score if you want to keep control of it at the end of the turn.
twist_ghyran_1_content_1_description: The underdog can pick one of the effects below. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner picks an enemy unit on the battlefield.
twist_ghyran_1_content_2_description: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield. Subtract 1 from save rolls for that unit this battle round.
twist_ghyran_1_content_3_description: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield. Ward rolls cannot be made for that unit this battle round.
twist_ghyran_2_description: To gain a foothold in the Realms of Life, one must plant the seeds of victory for future generations.
twist_ghyran_2_content_1_description: The underdog picks 2 objectives on the battlefield. If there is no underdog, each player picks 1 objective on the battlefield, starting with the active player.
twist_ghyran_2_content_2_description: Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of their turn for each of those objectives that they control.
twist_ghyran_3_description: The twisting vines burst from the undergrowth to ensnare hapless warriors.
twist_ghyran_3_content_1_description: The underdog picks an enemy unit on the battlefield. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner picks an enemy unit on the battlefield.
twist_ghyran_3_content_2_description: That unit is ensnared. Until the end of the battle round, halve its Move characteristic and roll 1 fewer dice when making a charge roll for that unit.
twist_ghyran_4_description: The verdant land of Ghyran is rich in natural resources waiting to be claimed.
twist_ghyran_4_content_1_description: Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of their turn if there are more friendly models contesting  the large terrain feature in enemy territory and there are no enemy models contersting it.
twist_ghyran_4_content_2_description: In addition, the underdog adds 1 to wound roll attacks made by friendly units that target a unit contesting a large terrain feature.
twist_ghyran_5_content_1_description: The underdog picks 1 objective on the battlefield. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner picks an objective on the battlefield.
twist_ghyran_5_content_2_description: That objective becomes a lifespring this battle round. Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of their turn if they control that objective.
twist_ghyran_5_content_3_description: In addition, at the end of each turn in this battle round, after victory points have been scored, Heal (1) each unit that is contesting that objective.
twist_ghyran_6_content_1_name: The underdog can pick one of the effects below. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner can pick the effect.
twist_ghyran_6_content_2_description: Pick a friendly unit on the battlefield. That unit has WARD (6+) this battle round. If this unita already has a ward instead add 1 to its ward save for this battle round instead.
twist_ghyran_6_content_3_description: Pick up to 3 different friendly units on the battlefield. Heal (D3) each of these units (roll for each).
twist_aqshy_1_description: Khorne's  presence is felt in this battle, and he demands blood be spilled in his name!
twist_aqshy_1_content_1_description: Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of their turn for each enemy unit destroyed that turn.
twist_aqshy_1_content_2_description: In addition, if one of the players is the underdog, that players picks 1 friendly unit on the battlefield to be Frenzied. Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by that unit this battle round.
twist_aqshy_2_description: A fire is stoked in the hearts of the embattled warriors, giving them the courage to push deep into enemy lines.
twist_aqshy_2_content_1_description: Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of their turn for each objective they control that was controlled by the opponent at the start of their turn.
twist_aqshy_2_content_2_description: In addition, the underdog picks 1 friendly unit to be the spearhead. That unit's melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) this battle round.
twist_aqshy_3_content_1_description: The underdog picks 1 objective on the battlefield. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner picks the objective.
twist_aqshy_3_content_2_description: That objective is no longer controlled by either player and cannot be contersted or controlled in this battle round.
twist_aqshy_3_content_3_description: In addition, at the end of the turn in this battle round, after victory points have been scored, inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit that has any models on it (roll for each unit).
twist_aqshy_4_description: Blood is spilled relentlessly in the pursuit of conquering this battle-scarred realm.
twist_aqshy_4_content_1_description: The underdog picks 2 objectives on the battlefield.
twist_aqshy_4_content_2_description: If there is no underdog, each player picks 1 objective on the battlefield, starting with the active player.
twist_aqshy_4_content_3_description: Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of their turn for each of those objectives they control.
twist_aqshy_5_description: Plumes of thick black smoke erupt from the scarred land, objscuring the warriors in battle.
twist_aqshy_5_content_1_description: The underdog picks 1 objective on the battlefield. If there is no underdog, the players roll off and the winner picks the objective.
twist_aqshy_5_content_2_description: That objective is wreathed in smoke. Until the end of the battle round, only unmodified hit rolls of 6 succesfully hit for attacks that target a unit contesting that objective.
twist_aqshy_6_content_1_description: The underdog picks 1 unit in each player's army that is on the battlefield to be bloodmarked, starting with the active player.
twist_aqshy_6_content_2_description: Each player scores 1 extra victory point at the end of the battle round if the enemy bloodmarked unit is destroyed this battle round.
